description: Returns one type's slug, name, page URL, definition, how it is measured from a front photo (the exact threshold rule) and its count and share among the 102 reference faces. Use this when you know the type, e.g. category 'face', slug 'oval'; call list_face_types first if you need the valid slugs, and classify_face_shape to decide which face shape a set of measurements is. Slug matching is case-insensitive; an unknown slug returns an error listing the valid slugs for that category, and an unknown category is rejected with a validation error. Read-only.

category.description: Which detector the type belongs to: face (face shape), eye, lip or nose.

slug.description: Type slug within that category, as returned by list_face_types, e.g. oval, heart (face), hooded (eye), cupids-bow (lip), upturned (eye), roman (nose).

name: get_face_type
title: Describe one face, eye, lip or nose type
